prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1279; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain radiating into the right buttock and posterior thigh. Initial evaluation documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and a restricted lumbar range of motion, consistent with a lumbar strain. Neurological screening showed intact sensation, reflexes, and strength in the lower extremities, while straight leg raise testing produced mild discomfort on the right. Imaging findings were reviewed, and the relationship between these symptoms and the collision has not yet been clearly established, so causation remains under review. The patient has no known prior injury or treatment involving the lumbar region. Care has been provided over 30 visits, consisting of manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction. Progress has been gradual, and the course of treatment has run somewhat longer than typically expected for a strain of this type. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Ongoing reassessment is planned to determine functional status and whether further care is warranted.
